facts.fact: The Xalam Analytics brief for the EU D4D Hub estimates Zambia had roughly 5 live commercial data centre facilities in 2024, with about 2MW of live critical IT load and about 60% occupancy; it names no facility in this count.
facts.system: Zambia commercial data centres (about five live facilities)

note: Liquid/ADC facility is expected around 2026-27, not in service; National Data Centre not stated to sell to outside customers.
